offer.note: A wish at the Blockshire well (paid to yourself)

npcs.name: Elder Bram
lines: Welcome to Blockshire, traveller. Warm yourself by the fire.
We are few, but the world beyond the fence is wide. One day you will see it.
Raiders come out of the forest every day now. Hilda and Gareth hold the gate, and Brother Anselm keeps them standing.
They say a wish at the well is heard, if you give something for it.

npcs.name: Mara the Cook
lines: Stew is on in an hour. Bring me nothing but an appetite.
If you go out to the gate, take something sharp. And stay near the priest.
One sits on old Gorm's cart. You'll have to jump for it.

npcs.name: Tobin the Woodcutter
lines: Mind the axe. It bites wood and fingers alike.
These logs won't split themselves. Well, not yet. Ask me again next season.
Behind the Elder's hut, by the fence, something glitters. Not my business.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Tag! You're it! ...You're not very fast, are you?
Did you see the well glow? Mum says it grants wishes.
I'm the fastest in Blockshire. Also the only kid.

npcs.name: Odo the Smith
lines: Steel wants a steady hand and a good plan. The plans I have; the hands are yours.
A blueprint gets better the more you work from it. Mine are worn smooth.

npcs.name: Harbourmaster Ysolde
lines: Welcome to Saltwind. Mind the crabs, and never sing back to the sirens.
The tide brings wrecks, and the wrecks bring trouble.

npcs.name: Old Finn
lines: Fifty years I've fished this coast. The cove west of here? I don't fish there no more.
Drowned men walk by the old wreck at night. Day too, lately.

npcs.name: Marisol
lines: Crab stew tonight! If somebody brings me crabs, that is.
The Salty Gull pours the best grog on the coast. The only grog, too.

npcs.name: Registrar Aldous
lines: Welcome to Genesis, traveller. This city is not built yet -- it will be built by those who live in it.
Every plot inside the wall has its number: houses to the north and south, workshops in the east, shops along the gate street.
Soon you will buy a plot here. Its deed is yours, and what you build on it is yours too.
Own two plots side by side, and you may build one great building over both.
npcs.greet: Welcome to the registry of Genesis. Pick a plot on the plan, and it can be yours.

npcs.name: Guildmaster Rowan
lines: The Adventurers' Guild. Out there are boars, wolves, goblins and worse, and the city needs what they guard.
Soon this board will hold work for every day: hunts, deliveries, things to fetch. Come back, and come back again.
Until then: Blockshire's elder and the people of Saltwind have tasks for you.
npcs.greet: The board has work for you, as every day.

npcs.name: Mabel the Innkeeper
lines: Come in, come in! A warm fire and a cold ale, that is what the Green Boar is for.
Everyone who comes through the west gate stops here first. You hear things, at an inn.
They say raiders camp south of Blockshire, and spiders nest under Greenwood. Mind yourself.

npcs.name: Sister Elowen
lines: Peace be with you. The temple's doors are open to all who come to Genesis.
One day the light will bless those who ask. For now, rest a while; this is a quiet place.

npcs.name: Hob the Stablemaster
lines: Stables, aye. No horses yet -- the roads east are not safe enough to bring them in.
When there are mounts, you'll find them here, by the east gate.

npcs.name: Wynn the Hunter
lines: Mind the wolves to the north. They hunt in threes, and they do not give up.
Pelts and fangs, that is what the forest pays with. Bring me some, one day I'll make it worth your while.
Deeper west the trees turn black with webs. I don't go there any more.

npcs.name: Foreman Tamsin
lines: Every beam in Genesis comes through this camp. Or it will, once there's a city to speak of.
The oaks round here are good and straight. Take an axe to them if you need logs for your own walls.
Raiders took two of our carts last week. If you see Grimwald, give him one from me.

npcs.name: Old Hennick
lines: Halfway between Blockshire and Genesis -- a good place for a rest, and a better one for news.
The spiders have a cave under Greenwood Deep, they say. Far to the west, by the black trees.
At night the raiders come up from their camp south of the village. You'll see their fire from the cliff.

npcs.name: Farmer Hal
lines: The boars get into the fields every night. Every single night.
Flax and wheat, that's what we grow. Genesis will need bread, once people live there.
The mill grinds when the wind is up. Listen -- you can hear the sails from the road.

npcs.name: Old Ulf
lines: From up there you see the whole coast: the village on its cliff, the raiders' fire, Genesis' wall.
Thirty years I've watched this sea. The pirates come from the west, mark my words.
When the moon is up, the raiders move. I light the beacon, and Blockshire's guards get ready.

npcs.name: Ysolde the Merchant
lines: Silks from the coast, iron from the hills, salt from Saltwind -- whatever Genesis needs, we bring it.
We camp outside the wall. The city's levy is ten in a hundred, and we'd rather keep that tenth.
Once the shops in town are open, we'll trade with them. Until then, the road is our market.

npcs.name: Sir Aldric
lines: The lists of Genesis! Empty now, but one day the city's champions will meet here.
Keep your guard up and your feet under you. The rest is practice.
When the city has a council, there will be tourneys, and prizes worth fighting for.

quests.title: Wood for the Hearth
quests.offer: Winter comes early up here. Bring me three oak logs from the old oaks around the village, and I will lend you my second axe.
quests.done: Good, solid oak. Here, take the axe -- and mind your fingers.

quests.title: A Boar for the Pot
quests.offer: The stew wants meat. Four boars roam the meadows east and south of the village. Bring them down, and I will stitch you a jerkin from the hides.
quests.done: That will feed the whole village! Here is your jerkin, still warm.

quests.title: Steel for the Gate
quests.offer: The wilds grow bolder every night. Go to the forge east of the square and make a weapon with your own hands.
quests.done: A fine first piece. The village is stronger for it. Take this shield; you will need it.

quests.title: Wolves at Night
quests.offer: I heard wolves howling in the Greenwood north of the village! Three of them! Can you make them stop? Please?
quests.done: It is quiet now! You can have my lucky coin. It is very lucky. Mostly.

quests.title: The Spider Nest
quests.offer: West of the village, deep in the Greenwood, the forest grows dark. Spiders nest there and take our herb gatherers. Kill three and bring peace back.
quests.done: You have done Blockshire a great service. These gloves were woven from their own silk -- wear them with pride.

quests.title: Crab Stew
quests.offer: Six shore crabs, that's all I need. South along the sand from here, where the shore bends towards Blockshire. They pinch, so mind your fingers.
quests.done: Look at these! Stew for the whole harbour. Here, take some sea salt for your trouble -- and a pearl I found in one.

quests.title: Songs in the Shallows
quests.offer: Sirens sing on the shoal off the north strand, knee-deep in the cove, and our fishermen walk into the sea. Silence four of them before we lose another boat.
quests.done: Quiet at last. Their charms are said to sharpen the mind. Wear this one.

quests.title: Rest for the Drowned
quests.offer: My old crew lies on the north strand, west of the black ship's dock. Something won't let them rest. Put four of them back in the sand, will you?
quests.done: Thank you. Here, my old sea boots. They've seen more storms than you have.

quests.title: The Black Sails
quests.offer: That ship at the old dock on the north shore flies black sails. Captain Blackgill raids our boats every week. Take the shore path with friends, board her and end him.
quests.done: Blackgill is gone? Then Saltwind can fish in peace. Take his coat -- it suits a hero better than a thief.

quests.title: First Blueprints
quests.offer: You want to make things? Bring me three lumps of copper ore from the boulders out in the hills, and I will give you my first blueprints: a sword, an axe and bracers.
quests.done: Good ore. Here are the plans. Use them at the forge; they get better every time you do.

quests.title: Wood and Hide
quests.offer: Not everything is iron. Three oak logs and a scrap of leather, and you shall have my woodwork: a shield, a charm and a tusk amulet.
quests.done: That will do. These are the plans; the wood is yours to work.

quests.title: Cloth and Shell
quests.offer: Last of what I have: two bundles of flax and two crab shells from the shore, and the plans for a tunic, a belt, a jerkin, a shell shield and a coral ring are yours.
quests.done: That is all I can teach from paper. The rest you will find yourself, or buy.

quests.title: Wolf Trouble
quests.offer: The wolves of Greenwood North have grown bold. Bring down six of them, and I'll give you a mantle of their skins.
quests.done: Six! The forest is quieter already. Here -- it'll keep the rain off.

quests.title: A Ring of Fangs
quests.offer: Wolf fangs make a fine ring, if you know how. Bring me four, and I'll show you -- and give you the plans.
quests.done: Good fangs, sharp ones. The plans are yours -- a jeweler's work, at a jeweler's bench.

quests.title: Oak for Genesis
quests.offer: Genesis needs beams, and my crew is short. Fell ten oaks round the camp and bring me the logs.
quests.done: Ten good logs. That's a roof for somebody. Take this axe, it's better than the one you've got.

quests.title: Boars in the Fields
quests.offer: Eight boars, every night, in my fields. Thin them out for me, and you'll have boots fit for mud.
quests.done: Ha! Maybe I'll get a harvest this year after all. The boots are yours.

quests.title: The Raiders' Camp
quests.offer: Every night I light the beacon because of them. Go to their camp south of Blockshire and break it: six raiders.
quests.done: Six fewer to watch for. You fight well -- better than I did at your age.

quests.title: Grimwald
quests.offer: Their chief is Grimwald. As long as he lives, they'll keep coming. End it.
quests.done: Grimwald is gone? Then tonight I'll sleep. Take this ring -- it was my captain's.

quests.title: Into the Dark
quests.offer: Travellers vanish near the black trees in the west. There's a cave there, full of spiders. Kill ten, and come tell me what you saw.
quests.done: A whole nest, under our feet... Here, something for your trouble, and keep your lantern lit.

quests.title: The Broodmother
quests.offer: Where there are that many, there's a mother. Deep in that cave, past the chasm. Kill her, if you can.
quests.done: You did it? Then Greenwood owes you more than I can pay. Take this, at least.

quests.title: Silk for the Road
quests.offer: Spider silk sells well on the coast. Bring me six, and I'll give you the plans for silk gloves.
quests.done: Beautiful, strong silk. The plans, as promised -- a tailor's work.

quests.title: Bars and Blades
quests.offer: Ore is only the start. Bring me four lumps of copper ore, and I'll show you how to pour bars -- and what to make of them.
quests.done: Good ore. Bars, blades, hilts, rivets, buckles: here are the plans. A longknife is the first thing a smith makes from his own parts.

quests.title: Planks and Handles
quests.offer: A log is no use to a carpenter until it's sawn. Bring me four oak logs and I'll teach you planks, handles and shield boards.
quests.done: There you are. Saw, plane, and mind the grain -- the plans are yours. Antler makes good buttons, too.

quests.title: Hides into Leather
quests.offer: The deer in the glades give the best hides around. Bring me two, and I'll show you how to tan them and cut straps.
quests.done: Nice and clean. Tanning, straps, and the jerkin I wear myself -- the plans are yours.

quests.title: Thread and Cloth
quests.offer: My wife spins the flax, but she's only two hands. Three bundles of flax and two hare pelts, and you'll have her plans.
quests.done: She says you'll learn quick. Thread, cloth, fur lining -- and trousers and gloves to make from them.

quests.title: Wire and Settings
quests.offer: Fine work sells best on the road. Bring me three lumps of copper ore and an antler, and I'll give you a jeweler's first plans.
quests.done: Wire, settings, clasps, a mould for rings, beads of antler -- and three things to make with them. Copper bars you'll need from a smith.

quests.title: Prove Yourself
quests.offer: Words are cheap in the lists. Show me what you can do: two goblins from the Goblin Bridgehead in the north.
quests.done: Not bad at all. The city will have need of fighters like you. Take this shield.

links.text: You climb down into the dark. Webs brush your face.
You climb back up into the daylight of Greenwood.
A long climb, and you are out in Greenwood again.

hoards.text: You lift the lid of the Broodmother's hoard.
hoards.empty: The hoard has nothing more for you today. Come back tomorrow.

hoards.text: You break open the raiders' chest.
hoards.empty: You have emptied it already today.

revives.text: You wake in the cave's first grotto. Something skitters away in the dark.
The fishers of Saltwind pull you out of the surf and lay you by the fire.
You wake on the pirates' dock, soaked. The sea spat you back.
